arguments.summary: No qualifying Dallas Industrial closed sales were found within 8 miles and 71,500–159,500 sf between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31. Many candidates were excluded by executed amendments moving the market to Seattle as of 2026-08-20; others failed size, distance, consideration, transaction-type, redevelopment, or publication-date rules. A comps grid XLSX with headers and a note has been generated.
limitations: Only the provided base extracts and executed amendments effective on/before 2026-08-31 were used; no external corroboration.
Several Dallas records were invalidated by entity-level market updates to Seattle effective 2026-08-20; if those are reversed or refined later, results could change.
One nearby closed sale (R8114) lacked consideration, preventing qualification despite meeting other filters.
A record with post-cutoff publication (R7726) was excluded by rule; earlier evidence could alter eligibility if available.
Data entry anomalies (e.g., size unit reported as acre for R3387) could not be corrected without additional evidence.
